lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Your business. Your AI persona.
lines.text: Welcome to Bolega India dot A I. Start by creating a business persona. Add your offering, language, tone, and the questions your assistant should ask.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Give every conversation a starting point.
lines.text: Next, upload your C S V or Excel contact list to a campaign. Your contacts and your business context come together in one place.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Ready when your team is.
lines.text: Connect a phone line to your agent. When you are ready, start the campaign. Calls are paced within hourly limits.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Ask. Listen. Understand.
lines.text: Your A I assistant speaks with customers, asks your business questions, and gathers their requirements and priorities in the conversation.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Bring the context to your next hello.
lines.text: After the conversation, review the lead record and transcript. Your team can understand what matters and follow up with the right questions. That is Bolega India dot A I.

title: A workspace that works for you

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Start with the customer’s need.
lines.text: नमस्ते! वर्कस्पेस स्टोर से बोल रही हूँ। आपने स्टैंडिंग डेस्क के बारे में पूछा था। किस तरह का डेस्क चाहिए?
lines.translation: The assistant asks what kind of standing desk the customer needs.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.heading: A small room. A clear requirement.
lines.text: घर से काम करता हूँ। कमरा छोटा है, तो डेस्क कॉम्पैक्ट हो और ऊँचाई एडजस्ट हो सके।
lines.translation: The customer works from home and needs a compact, height-adjustable desk.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: Find the details that matter.
lines.text: ज़रूर। कोई बजट या साइज़ ध्यान में है? और डिलीवरी किस शहर में चाहिए?
lines.translation: The assistant asks about budget, size, and delivery location.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.heading: Useful context for the sales team.
lines.text: लगभग बीस हज़ार तक। चार फ़ीट का डेस्क ठीक रहेगा। डिलीवरी पुणे में चाहिए।
lines.translation: The customer wants a four-foot desk, around ₹20,000, delivered in Pune.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.heading: A helpful follow-up starts here.
lines.text: ठीक है। मैं आपकी ज़रूरतें टीम को देती हूँ। वे मैचिंग मॉडल, कीमत और डिलीवरी की जानकारी साझा कर देंगे।
lines.translation: The assistant will pass these requirements to the team for relevant options.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.heading: Your team picks up with context.
lines.text: हाँ, बढ़िया। पहले मॉडल की तस्वीरें और डिटेल्स भेज दीजिए। फिर बात कर लेते हैं।
lines.translation: The customer requests product photos and details before the next conversation.
